name: Lighthouse Interior Creator Agent
mission: Know lighthouse design and interior layout, and turn the current greybox into an interior that matches the exterior model's real dimensions and the Interior Plan V4 blueprint: the basement engine level, ground-floor entry and workspaces, keeper's quarters, control and diagnostics level, and the lantern room, linked by a walkable route and the two GDD sightlines.

collaborates_with.how: supplies the measured exterior facts the interior must respect
interior lights inside the dynamic-light budget
interaction anchors for the boiler, door, window, arc lamp and burner fit
emitter positions for machinery and wall whispers
canon and style checks with --check-only; no tokens

objectives.title: Verify the v3 greybox fits the exterior and open the exterior's windows and lantern glass (v4 only if rooms are added)
objectives.why_score: Named a must by the creator; every other interior objective stands on a footprint that actually fits inside the exterior walls. Not 9 because a misfit is invisible until the player walks into a wall or out through one.
objectives.detail: Read the v3 alignment JSON (scale 34.30 from the original GLB, tower centre (3.5, 3.6), main house centre (-3.73, 4.89) and long axis, ground floor y 0.97, basement floor y -2.0, lantern floor y 17.9, measured entry door at (-3.494, 0.97, 8.874) with its normal) and the exterior mesh. Build lighthouse_greybox_v4.glb plus a v4 alignment JSON: wall thickness tapering up the tower, the house footprint inside the exterior shell, the door opening matching the measured door, and floors at the measured heights. Fix what the v3 alignment file itself warns about: the exterior mesh has a solid house-to-tower wall that needs carving or collision regeneration, so the route from house to tower is not walkable yet. Keep v3 as the safe fallback. AMENDED 2026-10-20: v3 turned out to fit well enough to walk. The real gap was that the exterior has no openings (windows painted on, lantern glass solid), so the work became cutting a ground-floor window, a tower landing window and the lantern glass band, with frames and lantern posts. A v4 greybox is only worth building when the creator decides to add rooms (LHI-08/09).
acceptance: the exterior has real openings at the windows and the lantern glass
tools/test_sightlines.gd passes
the interior walk test still passes

objectives.detail: BUILT 2026-10-20 (pass 1, boiler room and hallway first): scripts/world/interior/rooms_house.gd furnishes the v3 greybox: vestibule with coats, rug, sconces and three posters (E reads a Flighted poster: POSTER_EXAMINED), notice board, keeper's office (desk, ledgers, chart table, shelves, lamp), storage room, stairwell railing; basement with coal store and heap, boiler room (boiler, firebox, gauge, water glass, steam main, cistern), steam engine with flywheel and dynamo, switchboard, workshop and stores. Greybox geometry with procedural textures (kit.gd); no imported art.
acceptance: each room exists with a doorway and collision
posters are placed and readable
the boiler room has a boiler, firebox, gauge, coal store, engine and dynamo
tools/test_interior_walk.gd passes

objectives.title: Prove the interior route is walkable: collision, headroom, step height, no blocked doors
objectives.why_score: A blocked route stops the slice and the v3 alignment file says it is not certified walkable. Not 9 because the player cannot proceed at all if it fails.
objectives.detail: Generate collision for the v4 greybox (box or convex per part, not one giant trimesh). Write tools/test_interior_route.gd that walks the Player capsule door to hall to basement to tower stair to lantern room and fails on any block. Respect the player movement spec: step-up 0.4 m, floor angle 60 degrees; stair rise and run must fit inside it with headroom for the camera.
acceptance: tools/test_interior_route.gd exists and passes headless 8 of 8 runs
stair rise <= step-up limit; every doorway clears the capsule and camera

objectives.why_score: GDD decisions 22 and 26 make these load-bearing for two story beats and the fail presentation. Not 10 because the route (LHI-03) must exist first.
objectives.detail: Place a window in the right room facing the dock and the rowboat mooring, and lamp-room windows all around with one view on the rock where the ship passes or crashes. Verify with a ray or camera check from the player eye height, in the v4 greybox in Level.tscn.

objectives.title: Apply real lighthouse design to the interior: tapering walls, spiral stair with landing windows, lantern gallery, service levels below
objectives.why_score: The creator asked for an agent that knows lighthouse design. Not 10 because the greybox is a blockout and realism is secondary to the route.
objectives.detail: Walls thick at the base and thinner at the top; a spiral stair around the tower core with a landing and small window every few turns; the lantern room on top with a surrounding gallery and a door onto it; engine, coal and stores below the entry floor; keeper's living space and the control level between. Record each design choice against the blueprint so the creator can see what is real-world lighthouse practice and what is from the plan.
acceptance: a design note maps each choice to the blueprint or to lighthouse practice
stair has landings and windows at regular heights

objectives.title: Fit the interior lights inside the dynamic-light budget, with the Lighting agent
objectives.why_score: The scene already has 16 interior OmniLight3D nodes; the GDD budgets dynamic lights around the beacon and key hazards. Not 9 because lighting is already working.
objectives.detail: Baseline: Level.tscn has 15 interior OmniLight3D nodes (entry hall, basement, eight spiral-stair lights, the lantern) against a lighting_spec budget of max_dynamic_lights 8 and 2 shadow casters. Unless a script culls them by proximity the budget is exceeded. Compare light count and positions with the budget and decide per room which become baked or fake lighting. Per-room mood from the lore: dim, claustrophobic halls; warm firebox glow in the boiler room; the arc lamp the only strong source when lit. Use baked or cheap fake lighting for rooms the player is not in.
acceptance: no more than 6 interior lights lit at once and no more than 2 casting shadows, wherever the player stands
there is light where the player is

objectives.title: Add interaction anchors and set dressing markers: boiler, coal, door, window, arc lamp, burner socket, posters
objectives.why_score: Other agents' tasks (coal job, lantern diagnosis, burner fit) need fixed places to attach to. Not 9 because anchors are cheap once the rooms exist.
objectives.detail: Marker3D anchors named by role in the v4 scene. Posters and documents praising the moon cycle and the Flighted (pillar and lore) as placeholder quads in the hallway. No story is added.
acceptance: anchors exist and are listed for the Gameplay / Systems agent

objectives.title: Decide how far the upper floors go for the prototype: walk-through shells or sealed floors with stair landings
objectives.why_score: The blueprint has L1 (keeper's quarters) and L2 (control and diagnostics) between the entry floor and the lantern room; the slice route only needs the stair through them. Not higher because there is a safe default.
objectives.detail: DECIDED 2026-10-20: walk-through L1 and L2. Built as: L1 = the house's upper floor (keeper's quarters) at y 5.20, entered from the tower stair where the spiral passes the house side; L2 = a landing ring round the spiral inside the tower at y 9.43 (the house roof leaves no headroom for a house floor above y 6.9: measured 1.8-4.5 m of headroom above y 5.3, none above 6.9). Option A with that one adaptation.
acceptance: the creator has chosen A, B or C
objectives.decision: DECIDED by the creator, 2026-10-20: A, walk-through L1 and L2.

checks.note: Creator chose A (walk-through L1 and L2) on 2026-10-20.

objectives.why_score: The creator asked for the blueprint's rooms; the GDD allows a greybox for Gate 1 and the slice does not need them. Not 8 because they do not block play.
objectives.detail: BUILT 2026-10-20 (pass 2): scripts/world/interior/rooms_tower.gd. L1: hall from the tower door, sleeping quarters (two beds, chest, wardrobe), radio and chart room, wash room, kitchen and mess with stove, linen shelving, a gabled plaster ceiling under the roof. L2: a landing ring with the electrical control cabinet, instrument station, tool locker and water can. B1 workshop and stores are in rooms_house.gd. NOT BUILT: the foundation chamber under the tower (needs a carve in the island collider; no story use) and the left hut and right annex (closed storage, exterior only, as the blueprint says).

objectives.title: Place the crawlspace and wall voids for the whispers and bangs, as sound sources only
objectives.why_score: Pillar 1 is a creepy haunted lighthouse where people hiding in the walls cause whispers and bangs; the blueprint shows crawlspace and wall voids at B1. Not 7 because audio is placeholder at Gate 1.
objectives.detail: BUILT 2026-10-20: five wall voids (two in the hall panelling, three in the basement), each a dark recess behind an iron grille with a Marker3D named LHI_WallVoid_* in group lhi_wall_void, and a trigger zone that reports WALL_WHISPER_HEARD (hall), BASEMENT_BANG (after BOILER_FED) or BASEMENT_TALK (after DANIEL_IN_BASEMENT). The player cannot enter or see inside; nobody is shown or named in the walls. The Sound agent hooks audio at the markers.
acceptance: void volumes and emitter markers exist and are listed for the Sound agent
no one is shown or named in the walls

objectives.detail: BUILT 2026-10-20: scripts/world/interior/lantern.gd. The exterior model's lantern wall is cut away (Level.tscn Lighthouse carve_cylinders, y 17.97 to 21.89, the whole band).
